page_or_component: Tickets page – CityLights Ticket Offers heading
wcag_reference: WCAG 2.2 – 1.1.1 Non-text Content; 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
evidence: W3C's annotated inaccessible Tickets page identifies the heading as an image of text with no text alternative and no semantic heading markup.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may miss the heading and its structural relationship; users relying on text alternatives cannot obtain the heading information.
recommended_fix: Replace the image-of-text heading with real HTML heading text (for example, h2) styled with CSS; if an image remains, provide an equivalent text alternative.

evidence: W3C's Before-and-After annotations identify the concert dates table as not linearizing correctly and show missing/incorrect structural relationships.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may receive table information in an unclear order and may not understand which values belong to which headers.
recommended_fix: Use semantic table markup with caption, th headers, and appropriate scope/headers relationships so the table remains understandable when read linearly.

evidence: W3C documents the Tickets page text color #41545D on background #A9B8BF and reports insufficient contrast; the W3C easy-check page gives the example contrast ratio as 3.76:1.
user_impact: People with low vision or reduced contrast sensitivity may have difficulty reading ticket-price information.
recommended_fix: Change foreground/background colors to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text under WCAG 2.2 AA, then re-test the affected text.

evidence: W3C's annotation states that the image displays the phone number '(1) 269 M-U-S-I-C' but its alt text only says 'music line phone number', which is not an equivalent alternative.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not receive the actual phone number needed to purchase tickets.
recommended_fix: Replace the image with real text or provide an equivalent alt text containing the actual phone number; make the number a telephone link where appropriate.

evidence: W3C's annotation identifies the seat-option acronyms 'FS', 'RS', 'DC', and 'ST' as unexplained abbreviations.
user_impact: Users who do not understand the abbreviations, including some screen-reader users, may not know what ticket options mean.
recommended_fix: Expand each abbreviation at first use or provide an accessible explanation/definition so the meaning is clear.
